description:
Pay an x402 resource on the SHIELDED rail (scheme vauban-shielded-strk20). Starknet Sepolia only: an offer on any other network is refused as unpayable (network_not_supported).
It reads the offer, builds the X-VAUBAN-SHIELDED-SETTLEMENT header (vzk20-v2: pool coordinates plus a COMMITMENT), sends the STARK proof named by proof_path as the POST body, and returns the receipt from PAYMENT-RESPONSE.
THE PROOF: proof_path names a proof file you already hold, READ FROM YOUR DISK AND SENT to url as given. It is read only inside the directory named by PAY_MCP_SHIELDED_PROOF_DIR (no default: unset, nothing is read, code proof_dir_unset), relative to it or absolute inside it, never through a symbolic link (proof_path_symlink) or a '..' component (proof_path_traversal), never outside it (proof_path_outside_dir), and only when the file has the form of a proof (proof_form_invalid); each refusal comes before any request. The offer says which proof it wants (extra.proof); an offer that asks for another form is refused before any upload (proof_form_mismatch).
THE WITNESS: the witness that opens the commitment is yours. Pass it and this tool checks locally that it opens the commitment, that it is strictly under the published ceiling, and that neither of its numbers appears in the receipt served back. It is never sent, never returned and never logged; only the commitment travels. Or pass amount_commitment alone and the witness never reaches this tool at all.
Scope: through the pool, the payer does not appear in the payment transaction; the payer's deposit into the pool is a public transaction of its own.
THE PURCHASE SALT: when PAY_MCP_WITNESS_DIR names a directory and payer_pseudonym is given, this tool draws one fresh random salt for this purchase, keeps it there in a 0600 file (purchase_salt_kept_at), and sends only a value derived from it: the salt itself never leaves this process. Keep that file: a merchant that supports it may ask for it to match this purchase to you. Without either, no salt is drawn, the header is byte-identical to before, and the payment is unaffected. settlement_header in the answer is shown without the derived value, because that answer is read by things that log.
PRIVATE RECEIPT: when the offer provides one and this tool drew a purchase salt, it comes back under extra.vauban_redeem_receipt_private.
Outcomes, never conflated: paid (200, receipt), refused (402 after a real submission, the facilitator's own reason verbatim; code replayed_settlement when the value leg was already served once), unpayable (this client will not pay THIS offer: not on Starknet Sepolia, no shielded offer, amountIsCeiling not declared, the offer binds another commitment, the offer asks for another proof form, the witness does not open the commitment, the blinding is shorter than 128 bits or one repeated byte (weak_blinding), the witness is not under the ceiling), unreachable (transport), no_payment_required (the resource was free).

amount_commitment.description: The commitment as felt252 hex, when you computed it yourself.

payer_pseudonym.description: Optional. The payer pseudonym your proof publishes (its subject), felt252 hex. Needed, with the vault variable, for the purchase salt; it is not sent as such.

proof_path.description: A STARK proof file you hold, inside the directory named by PAY_MCP_SHIELDED_PROOF_DIR (relative to it, or absolute inside it). Its bytes are sent to url. .gz is gunzipped.

settlement.description: The pool transaction that settled the value leg. Every field is a CLAIM: the facilitator decides.

amount_blinding.description: Only for an offer that declares extra.amountBlindingRequired (open offer: amount is the exact price): the 0x-hex blinding of your commitment. Refused for any other offer, never returned.

block_number.description: Height of the block holding that transaction.

nullifier.description: Optional. Omitted rather than sent empty when absent.

url.description: The gated resource (http(s)). GET it, read the 402, POST the proof back to it.

witness.description: Optional, and it NEVER leaves this process: used only to check the commitment, the ceiling, and that neither number is in the receipt served back.

amount.description: The settled amount, decimal or 0x-hex, as a STRING (a JSON number loses precision past 2^53).

blinding_hex.description: The 0x-hex blinding that opens the commitment. Keep it: without it the receipt can no longer be checked.

name: pay_shielded
